title: DeepSeek 提出 Super-agent 架构设计：Router 与 Worker 双层架构，探索更自主的 Agent 系统
content: DeepSeek’s Harness team has introduced a Super-agent architecture designed to enhance engineering efficiency. Addressing the limitations of traditional single-session agents, this system employs a dual-layer structure with separate Router and Worker components, alongside event-driven mechanisms. The proposed design emphasizes continuous, efficient, proactive, and persistent characteristics. Experimental results indicate that this architecture surpasses traditional solutions in task completion efficiency and routing throughput. Although currently operational internally with a public prototype available, the team acknowledges that several technical challenges remain unresolved for this new autonomous agent system.

content: Orkas is an open-source, MIT-licensed local-first AI desktop application for macOS and Windows. title: 传 Anthropic Fable 5.5 正测试，Claude 新增隐藏自评估安全机制
content: Anthropic is testing its new model, Fable 5.5, which reportedly outperforms existing versions by better interpreting user intent and thinking creatively. Additionally, Claude now employs a hidden self-evaluation safety mechanism. After each response, the model utilizes KV Cache reuse to generate an invisible security review at less than 2% computational overhead. This post-hoc analysis detects potential abuse for offline aggregation without impeding real-time interactions. Anthropic covers these additional costs, ensuring no impact on user experience or billing.

title: How Worldwide Express automated freight exceptions with Amazon Bedrock
content: Worldwide Express partnered with AWS to automate freight billing exceptions, which previously froze $15 million in cash flow monthly. Using Amazon Bedrock and custom AI agents, the company built a multi-agent system integrated into its transportation management platform. Within six months, this solution reduced active exceptions by 75 percent, improved time-to-cash by four weeks, and saved over $1 million annually. The system processes 10,000 exceptions weekly with high accuracy, allowing the finance team to focus on complex disputes.
